review_target: Customer self-service booking wizard (/customer portal, BookingWizard) — five-step flow plus terminal screens

source_context.environment: repository, plus one local development-harness session

evidence_sources.demonstrates: Staff/customer split; create_customer_booking_group is the only customer write path; the three BEFORE INSERT gates; the claim that offline mode never touches real customer data
evidence_sources.limitations: Self-flags possible staleness; its offline-safety claim is contradicted for the customer portal by E11 and E23

evidence_sources.demonstrates: The portal's gated lifecycle (login, human record, password, signup approval, profile) establishing that every wizard user is authenticated and approved
evidence_sources.limitations: Static inspection only; the gates were never exercised

evidence_sources.demonstrates: Composition root: five steps, draft persistence, reschedule and approval modes, pre-commit client re-check, deposit read-back, error-code mapping, all terminal screens, funnel and denial telemetry
evidence_sources.limitations: Static inspection; never executed in an authenticated session

evidence_sources.demonstrates: Step 1: four-dog cap; pregnant and unknown-size dogs disabled with an inline reason; a WhatsApp escape hatch provided for pregnancy only
evidence_sources.limitations: Static inspection; not rendered

evidence_sources.demonstrates: Step 2: per-dog service choice, size-filtered options, apply-to-everyone shortcut, starting-price framing
evidence_sources.limitations: Static inspection; not rendered

evidence_sources.demonstrates: Step 3: 28-day paging, capacity-aware day states, the incomplete-availability hint that withholds the legend, the last-minute affordance, skeleton loading, full accessible day names
evidence_sources.limitations: Static inspection; only its degraded state was rendered (E23)

evidence_sources.demonstrates: Step 4: grouped drop-off times, per-human preferred and blocked slots, the explicit distinction between a fetch failure and a genuinely full day, the waitlist offer, the same-day fail-closed filter
evidence_sources.limitations: Static inspection; not rendered

evidence_sources.demonstrates: Step 5, the commitment point: summary of when, dog, service and price; the phrase 'From £X (paid at pick-up)'; the cancellation note; submit disabled while submitting
evidence_sources.limitations: Contains no deposit awareness; not rendered

evidence_sources.demonstrates: Desktop-only sticky 'Your booking so far' panel, always rendered in the DOM and hidden by CSS below the two-column breakpoint
evidence_sources.limitations: Rendered only with harness-supplied mock props (E23)

evidence_sources.demonstrates: The responsive contract (sidebar hidden below 1024px, two-column and sticky above it), the deliberate strikethrough on fully-booked days as a non-colour cue, and two prefers-reduced-motion blocks
evidence_sources.limitations: CSS proves implemented rules, not rendered quality at every viewport

evidence_sources.demonstrates: The customer Supabase client is built purely from credential presence and never consults VITE_FORCE_OFFLINE
evidence_sources.limitations: Contradicts E21's source comments and E1's offline-safety claim

evidence_sources.demonstrates: The staff Supabase client does honour VITE_FORCE_OFFLINE, nulling both URL and key, establishing the asymmetry against E11
evidence_sources.limitations: Describes the staff client only

evidence_sources.demonstrates: The self-enforcing offline guard asserts that the staff client is null in every Vitest project
evidence_sources.limitations: Asserts nothing about customerClient, so the customer portal sits outside the guard

evidence_sources.demonstrates: get_open_days, get_occupancy_range and get_blocked_seats are each revoked from anon and granted only to authenticated
evidence_sources.limitations: Migration files; prod grants were not queried directly, though E23's 42501 responses corroborate them

evidence_sources.demonstrates: create_customer_booking_group is revoked from and re-granted only to authenticated, and is the sole customer write path
evidence_sources.limitations: Migration file; prod state not queried

evidence_sources.demonstrates: getBookingRules returns preferredSlots, blockedSlots and depositRequired, and is already called at step 4, where depositRequired is then discarded
evidence_sources.limitations: The read fails open and returns null on error, so a null result never proves that no deposit is required

evidence_sources.demonstrates: Booking horizon of 28 days by default, overridable between 1 and 730 by RPC, with a failed read never blocking a booking
evidence_sources.limitations: The configured production value was not read

evidence_sources.demonstrates: 11 test files and 38 tests pass, covering horizon boundaries, deposit truthfulness, partial reschedule, pregnancy gating, size verification, last-minute rules, calendar paging and full-day handling
evidence_sources.limitations: jsdom component tests prove implemented logic, not rendered quality or production behaviour

evidence_sources.demonstrates: By absence: all five Playwright specs are staff-facing, so the customer portal and its write path have no end-to-end coverage
evidence_sources.limitations: Directory listing and grep; the suite was not executed

evidence_sources.demonstrates: Currency: the surface was last touched on 2026-08-06 by a copy-truthfulness fix, preceded by the desktop summary sidebar and deposit-messaging work
evidence_sources.limitations: Command-line history only, not a hosted review record

evidence_sources.demonstrates: The only harness for this surface: it mounts the real sidebar and the real DateSelection, and substitutes static placeholders for every other step plus static mocks for the calendar legend and success screen
evidence_sources.limitations: Its comments claim offline nulls the customer client and that DateSelection cannot reach its complete branch for that reason; E23 shows the client is live and the true cause is server permission

evidence_sources.location: src/engine/capacity.ts, deposits.ts, denials.ts, slotGrid.ts, immediateBooking.ts, bookingRules.ts
evidence_sources.demonstrates: The wizard is a thin client over shared pure engines also used by the staff app and the Deno edge functions
evidence_sources.limitations: Logic only; engine parity with the database trigger was not re-verified in this review

evidence_sources.demonstrates: Rendered the wizard shell, the real sidebar at three fill states and the real DateSelection in its incomplete-availability state; measured single-column-no-sidebar-no-overflow at 390px and a 644px/320px grid at 1280px; measured 34x34px calendar day targets against 44x44px nav buttons; measured contrast of 4.45:1 on white and 4.23:1 on the wizard backdrop for secondary text, 1.89:1 for closed-day numerals and 17.31:1 for open-day numerals; confirmed accessible day names such as 'Friday 21 August, closed'
evidence_sources.limitations: Runs inside the staff app shell rather than the customer portal shell; screenshot capture failed because the browser pane stayed hidden, so all findings rest on the accessibility tree, computed styles and geometry; steps 1, 2, 4 and 5 were never rendered; the harness fired six live requests to production Supabase, all rejected with 401 and 42501 permission-denied, so no data was read and nothing was written

evidence_sources.location: supabase/migrations/20260712115759_legal_risk_tranche1.sql L1355-1670 (cancel_customer_booking), plus src/constants/salonSettings.ts L29 and L84
evidence_sources.demonstrates: Online cancellation is governed by two staff-configurable salon settings: customerPortal.allowCancellations (default true, toggleable in Settings) and minCancellationHours (default 24), measured backwards from the appointment's start time, raising SDC01 when disabled and SDC02 when the deadline has passed
evidence_sources.limitations: Contradicts step 5's hardcoded copy 'up until the day before' (E8). Migration file plus code defaults; the production salon_config values were not queried

inaccessible_sources: The authenticated customer portal and every wizard step in a real data state (steps 1, 2, 4 and 5 were never rendered)
Production analytics and the wizard's own funnel telemetry results (logFunnelEvent is emitted but its data was not available)
Real-customer research, interviews or observed sessions
Assistive-technology test results: actual screen-reader output, keyboard order through the 28-day grid, 200% zoom reflow and text scaling
Design files or visual specifications for this surface
The deposit, reschedule, approval-request and waitlist branches exercised end to end

owner_decisions.question: Should the wizard warn a deposit-required customer before they commit, using the depositRequired flag it already fetches at step 4?
owner_decisions.current_interpretation: It should. The surface enforces a strict post-commitment honesty standard pinned by tests, and the pre-commitment screen has simply not been brought up to it.
owner_decisions.why_it_matters: It decides whether the most consequential moment in the flow tells a subset of customers something the system already knows to be wrong.

owner_decisions.question: Which device should this surface be optimised for?
owner_decisions.current_interpretation: Unknown. Mobile-first implementation is confirmed, but implementation optimisation is not usage evidence, and none is available.
owner_decisions.why_it_matters: It decides whether the 34x34px calendar targets are the most important accessibility finding on this surface or a marginal one, and whether the desktop sidebar deserves further investment.

owner_decisions.question: Should customerClient.ts honour VITE_FORCE_OFFLINE as client.ts does, and should the offline guard test cover both clients?
owner_decisions.current_interpretation: Yes. The asymmetry appears accidental and costs the project both a stated safety guarantee and the ability to write an offline E2E for its only customer write path.
owner_decisions.why_it_matters: It is the precondition for end-to-end testing this surface and for reviewing it against real rendered states in future.

owner_decisions.topic: Cancellation-window copy at the commitment point
owner_decisions.question: Should step 5's cancellation sentence be corrected to the real rule, or derived from the configured settings?
owner_decisions.current_interpretation: It should at minimum be corrected. At the default of 24 hours before the appointment's start time, the current copy over-promises: a Tuesday 08:30 appointment cannot be cancelled on Monday evening, though 'up until the day before' says it can.
owner_decisions.why_it_matters: It is a second instance of hardcoded copy asserting a fact the server actually governs, at the same commitment point as the deposit gap.
